fixture: B01 homogeneous unsaturated, path length 10 cm, head envelope [-10000,-1] cm

early_falsification.reason: Every precommitted node-count/density candidate violates mandatory B3 equal-head gravity and B4 hydrostatic criteria on deterministic special probes. Ordinary B1 Sobol characterization is therefore not required to reject this representation family.
early_falsification.special_probe_heads: negative geometric spacing from -1 cm through -10000 cm
early_falsification.hydrostatic_probe_rule: h_below=h_above+10 cm where both endpoints remain within the frozen envelope

findings: Raw bilinear interpolation in effective saturation does not preserve the equal-head gravity line sufficiently over the four-decade head envelope.
Wet-end-only power densification improves hydrostatic error but worsens dry-end equal-head relative accuracy because the conductivity varies over many orders of magnitude.
Increasing the raw S-grid to 129 nodes per axis is not close to the precommitted B3/B4 thresholds, so this is a representation failure rather than a marginal density miss.
No holdout information was used and no holdout has yet been frozen.
next_action: Freeze and characterize a separate source-supported bounded-cost representation using a two-end smoothing coordinate and quadratic interpolation; do not alter this failed design retrospectively.
